mechanism: Echinacea may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing carvedilol metabolism; echinacea also has mild immunostimulant effects that could theoretically affect cardiovascular stability in patients with heart conditions.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate; counsel patient to inform provider of echinacea use; no dose adjustment typically necessary but remain alert for reduced carvedilol efficacy.
